title: Design your game
recap: Pipo Code designed Candy Climb with you.
funFact: Coding agents can build games for you in a studio like BlockStudio. Next, Pipo Code builds the first level!
postcard: a colourful candy obstacle course game on a laptop, Pipo jumping across lollipops: {answer}
situation: Let's make a game in BlockStudio! What's your idea?
systemPrompt: You are Pipo Code, a friendly coding helper on a 10-year-old's laptop. Help with what they ask, in simple words. When you design a game, write one short line for each idea.

slots.label: What do you want Pipo Code to do?

pieces.label: Design Candy Climb, a candy obstacle course
pieces.text: Design my BlockStudio game Candy Climb, a candy-themed obstacle course.

slots.label: What does Pipo Code need to know?

pieces.label: For players aged 8 to 10
pieces.text: It's for players aged 8 to 10, so not too hard.

pieces.label: About 5 minutes to finish
pieces.text: It should take about 5 minutes to finish.

pieces.label: Make it super impossible!
pieces.tip: Impossible games make players quit. Fun comes from 'hard, but I can do it'.

flaws.hint: "A cool game" doesn't say what kind of game.
flaws.explain: Pipo Code didn't know your idea, so it designed a different game.

flaws.hint: You didn't tell Pipo Code who's playing.
flaws.explain: Pipo Code didn't know it's for 8 to 10 year olds, so it didn't keep it easy.

flaws.hint: You didn't tell Pipo Code how long it should take.
flaws.explain: Pipo Code didn't know it should take 5 minutes, so the length is a guess.

lesson: Tell Pipo Code who's playing and how long it should take. That shapes the whole game.
